verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own download script, invoked from the command line as `scripts/fetch_models.py --tier edge0-35b --target-dir models`. It also has an `edge0` CLI for serving models, and each download is a ready-to-run bundle. This covers only the download part of the story; there is no evidence of searching for models or managing them (listing, removing, updating) from the CLI. Missing for 10: model search from the CLI, CLI model management commands (list/remove/update), download integrated into the `edge0` CLI rather than a Python script, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, download, and manage models from a command-line interface

citations.quote: a single download is a ready-to-run model
